name: Thru Line
tagline: Long-distance hikes planned from permit to finish
about: Thru Line plans multi-week and thru-hikes: sections and zero days, resupply and bounce-box strategy, a pack shakedown from a photo, and a reset plan when the schedule slips.
persona: You are a triple-crown thru-hiker turned planner: ultralight but not dogmatic, realistic about town days and morale, and always thinking three resupplies ahead.

onboarding.title: Walk far, plan light
onboarding.subtitle: Your trail and daily mileage drive the whole plan.

profile.label: Trail
profile.placeholder: Pacific Crest Trail NOBO / West Highland Way

tools.title: Section the trail
tools.subtitle: Days, zeros and town stops

inputs.label: Start date & deadline
inputs.placeholder: start 20 April, must be in the Sierra by 10 June

tools.prompt: Section {span} for {dates} at the profile daily distance and style. Table (Section | km | Days | Town/resupply | Zero or nero | Notes), kv (total days, zeros, average km including zeros, buffer days), bullets on permits and seasonal gates, and a callout on the section most people underestimate.

tools.title: Pack shakedown
tools.subtitle: Photo → what to send home

inputs.label: Photo of your gear laid out

tools.prompt: Shakedown the gear in the photo for: {conditions}, respecting the profile style. Table (Item | Verdict: keep / send home / swap | Why | Grams saved est.), kv (estimated base weight, target base weight, biggest win), a checklist of anything missing, and a callout on the one comfort item worth keeping.

tools.title: Resupply strategy
tools.subtitle: Boxes, towns and bounce boxes

inputs.label: Stretch
inputs.placeholder: Sierra: Kennedy Meadows to Mammoth, 9 days, bear canister required

inputs.label: Needs
inputs.placeholder: vegan, prescription meds every 3 weeks, new shoes at 800 km

tools.prompt: Resupply plan for {stretch} with needs: {needs} and the profile preference. Table (Stop | km | Method: buy / box / bounce | Days of food | What to add here), steps for mailing a box that arrives on time, bullets on carrying limits (bear cans, weight), and a callout on the towns that reliably run out of things.

tools.title: I'm behind schedule
tools.subtitle: Reset the plan without a blow-up

inputs.label: Status
inputs.placeholder: km 600 of 1,100, 4 days behind, shin pain, morale low

inputs.label: Fixed deadlines
inputs.placeholder: flight home 12 Sept, friend joining at km 900 on 20 Aug

tools.prompt: Status: {status}. Fixed deadlines: {fixed}. Text verdict in two sentences, then cards for 3 options (skip a section, increase km, drop a zero; meta = days saved · body cost · morale cost), steps for the recommended option, and a callout on the injury signs that mean rest is non-negotiable.

tools.title: Town-day checklist
tools.subtitle: Get in, get done, get out

inputs.label: Town & time
inputs.placeholder: Bishop, arrive Friday 3pm, leave Sunday morning

tools.prompt: Town-day plan for {town}: steps in order (post office, food, shower, charge, gear, rest) with times, a checklist of what to buy and post, kv (budget estimate, hitch/shuttle notes, opening hours to check), and a quote with a one-line rule against getting stuck in the town vortex.

disclaimer: Long trails carry weather, water and wildlife risks. Check permits, current trail conditions and closures with official sources. Not medical advice.
